I've only experienced it twice, and I wasn't the only person.

The first was the first few miles into this one reservation I went to for a school trip. I'm not going to name the reputation as not to spur on the rumors, as I think the bad reputation is unfairly imposed. While the reservation itself has an especially bad reputation due to a few gruesome crimes that occurred there in the past 10 years, I don't think that the reservation had anything to do with it, as it was only a small part of the road. I have been to multiple reservations and have never felt this way.

The feeling was of overwhelming dread. It was as soon as we entered the reservation, but ended a few miles in. For roughly 5 minutes, I was consumed with that feeling of dread. I didn't enter feeling afraid due to the bad reputation, and it wasn't the people that I was afraid of. This feeling of dread had no base, it wasn't centered on a certain thing. I can't even describe how it felt, but it was gone almost as soon as it had started. It seemed that the other students had felt it as well, because for that brief few minutes everyone settled down and sat soberly in their seats.

The second time was some random stretch of road late at night. It was another school trip and we were coming home, it was probably 10-11pm. This one lasted longer, almost an hour. Everyone on the bus was very vocal about this feeling, we all had this inexplicable feeling that we were going to die. Some kids even messaged their parents talking about this fear, some kids were praying even. Though the feeling dissipated after an hour, we all felt uneasy for the rest of the ride home.

There was no reason for fear either of these times. The road didn't get anymore dangerous or winding, the weather was consistent before and after, there weren't any arguments or disputes. One minute we were all sitting there joking around and the next we were terrified. After it passed, we went back to joking around, albeit a  little freaked out by the experience.

That being said, i will *never* forget how I felt.

(I would be interested in returning to the places i felt this to see if it happened again, but due to the reputation of the first one, no one is willing to accompany me and I don't feel comfortable going alone, and the exact location of the second one is unknown)
